g.text: ONE structural difference: v2 CLOSES the fixation loop (accumulated prediction-error/EFE -> next fixation); our loop is OPEN (RNG -> fixation, no feedback).

g.text: v1 substrate (glimpse, settle, action a(k)) is on-disk-traceable; the v2 focus-map internals are WebFetch-only (paper_ground_truth.md sec4a) and the equation is NOT traceable.
